issues.title: 模块选择错误: 应为Module Three, 实际Module Two
issues.description: Exporter role 'processor' + Importer role 'processor' → expected Module Three, but document declares Module Two.
issues.recommended_action: 将文档模块从 Module Two 改为 Module Three 并确认 Annex I.A 中的角色与模块一致。

issues.title: 第三国传输风险: Serbia
issues.description: 数据涉及向非充分性认定第三国的传输。TIA=缺失，Schrems II 补充措施=不足。
issues.recommended_action: 完成 TIA；针对第三国法律环境实施 Schrems II 补充措施。

issues.description: Exporter role 'processor' + Importer role 'processor' → expected Module Three, but document declares Module Two.
issues.recommended_action: Use Module Three instead of Module Two, or verify that the party roles in Annex I.A match the declared module.

issues.title: [HIGH] Annex II: Annex II (Technical and Organisational Measures) appears empty or could not be parsed. Without speci
issues.description: Annex II (Technical and Organisational Measures) appears empty or could not be parsed. Without specified TOMs, the SCC does not demonstrate adequate data protection safeguards.
issues.recommended_action: Complete Annex II with specific technical and organisational measures, including encryption standards, access controls, incident response, and data minimization practices.

issues.title: [HIGH] Clause 14: Third country transfer identified to: Serbia. No Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) has been provided.
issues.description: Third country transfer identified to: Serbia. No Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) has been provided. Under GDPR and Schrems II (C-311/18), a documented TIA is required before transferring personal data to a third country without an adequacy decision.
issues.recommended_action: Complete a TIA for transfers to Serbia. The TIA must: (1) assess the laws and practices of the destination country; (2) evaluate whether they impinge on the SCCs' effectiveness; (3) identify and implement supplementary measures as needed.

issues.title: [HIGH] Annex II: Third country transfer to non-adequate jurisdiction 'Serbia' requires Schrems II supplementary measu
issues.description: Third country transfer to non-adequate jurisdiction 'Serbia' requires Schrems II supplementary measures. Technical: NOT FOUND. Contractual: NOT FOUND. Organizational: NOT FOUND.
issues.recommended_action: Implement Schrems II supplementary measures: (1) Technical — end-to-end encryption with EU-held keys, zero-access architecture; (2) Contractual — government access notification obligation, commitment to challenge unlawful requests, transparency reporting; (3) Organizational — independent annual audit, data minimization.

issues.title: [HIGH] Annex II / TIA: Technical: partial (Technical measures are limited or not detected.). Contractual: missing. Organiza
issues.description: Technical: partial (Technical measures are limited or not detected.). Contractual: missing. Organizational: missing. Overall: insufficient.
issues.recommended_action: Technical: implement e2ee_eu_keys, basic_encryption_only | Contractual: add gov_access, onward_restrictions | Organizational: establish audit, logging, key_management
